scenicChapters.title: Kuiseb Pass → Gamsberg Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 115 km. 760 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Gamsberg Pass → Windhoek
scenicChapters.narrative: 302 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

gamsberg-pass-route-kuiseb-pass-windhoek.story: The highest point is about 1,850 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
